passages.context: Both distinct applications of Luke 18:9-14 were checked in the complete homily. Section 8 uses the Pharisee to show fasting fruitless without accompanying duties; section 13 uses his truthful accusation to show that truth does not license evil-speaking.
passages.notes: The two loci make different arguments and must not be collapsed into a single generalized reading.
